en: Black‑and‑white view of a European spa or resort town square or park, with people in early‑20th‑century clothing sitting on benches and strolling along paths. Behind the park stands a row of ornate multi‑story buildings with domes and decorative facades, bearing German‑language signs such as cafes, hotels, and shops. A horse‑drawn carriage waits near a lamppost on the right, while wooded hills and villas rise in the background.
